stem:
Ms. González is putting square stickers on a rectangular poster. Each sticker has an area of 1 square inch. She has already put some stickers on the poster as shown.

What is the area of the entire poster in square inches?
visual_elements: rectangle with 7 stickers along the top edge and 7 stickers along the left edge, each sticker is 1 square inch
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding that the stickers form the length and width of the poster, then calculating the area by multiplying these dimensions. Involves spatial reasoning and multiplication.
